integrity.theorem_scope: Complex dimension one, normalized Gaussian source and target Hilbert spaces, positive scalar weights, compact region; with fixed source parameters for the critical limit
integrity.verification: Analytic argument plus reproducible rational/numerical diagnostics. Tests do not certify universal statements.

scientific_limitations: Higher-dimensional anisotropy and non-Hilbert mixed norms are not treated.
The analytic singular spectrum and Hermite-Mehler diagonalization are already established methods.
An unlocated broader kernel-majorization theorem could imply part or all of the comparison.
title: An exact Schatten-order reversal between analytic and maximal Gaussian Fock projections
